_comment: The PsikiQ product ladder — the single source for the GHL products, their prices and their card images. Mirrors pricing.html; if a price changes there, change it here and re-run build_products.py, then sync_products.py. Prices are NZD ex-GST in WHOLE DOLLARS — GHL’s products API takes major units on this location (verified against the calendar-created product: amount=1500 renders as NZ$1,500). Do not use cents.

products.description: Ninety minutes on Zoom, run with you in the room. You leave with the finding written down and the one move that changes the band. Credited in full against a build or an engine started within 30 days.
